# AI Swiss Knife — Agent Router (v5.0.0-beta.1)
> Verified: 2026-11-27 | Active entries: 31 | Stale/degraded auto-excluded: 0
> Monitor-only frontier entries (research/watch-list.md) are intentionally excluded.

## Hardware Profiles (`swissknife resolve <target> --profile <id>`)
- [zero-card-cloud] Zero-Card Cloud: Verified $0 cloud gateways, non-autoregressive decision endpoints, and keyless RAG requiring no credit card.
- [16vram-64ram] 16GB VRAM + 64GB RAM Workstation: Zone 1 pure 16GB VRAM dense models paired with Zone 2 64GB DDR5 sparse MoE offloading.
- [mac-apple-silicon] Apple Silicon Mac (Unified Memory / MLX): Unified memory local inference via Apple MLX and llama.cpp Metal without a PCIe split.
